checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: allow melee hits to interrupt an enemy's windup (stagger during windup for non-bosses), rewarding punishing telegraphs.

impact_assessment.why: Hitting an enemy during its telegraph currently does nothing to the attack, so windups feel like they must be dodged rather than punished.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a skill-based interrupt layer and a dopamine hit for cancelling big attacks.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: staggerEnemy signature unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: sim only; balance: only windup (not attack) and non-bosses, so telegraphed attacks still complete once started.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test interrupt behaviour; existing tests pass; gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implement: staggerEnemy now staggers during windup (interrupt) for non-bosses; bosses and attacking enemies still complete their attack.
[3/3] Verify: 158 tests (2 new), lint, typecheck, build, mechanics, 8/8 gates; checklists: passed
Task 'mech-interrupt-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: melee overkill carryover - when a hit kills an enemy, half the excess damage spills to the nearest living enemy within 120px.

impact_assessment.why: Killing blows often waste damage; spillover rewards grouping enemies and creates satisfying chain clears.
impact_assessment.benefits: More dopamine on multi-kills, rewards aggressive positioning.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: damageEnemy signature unchanged, spillover internal and single-hop (no infinite chains); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: sim only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test spillover behaviour; existing tests pass; gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implement: overkill carryover in damageEnemy spills half excess damage to nearest living enemy within 120px (single hop, melee only).
[3/3] Verify: 160 tests (2 new), lint, typecheck, build, mechanics, 8/8 gates; checklists: passed
Task 'mech-overkill-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: critical hits restore 3 mana and extend the flow window by 0.5s, making crits feel rewarding.

impact_assessment.why: Crits deal more damage but have no secondary reward, so they feel like a stat bump rather than a dopamine moment.
impact_assessment.benefits: Crits become a moment to celebrate and extend the flow streak.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: damageEnemy signature unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: sim only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test crit reward; existing tests pass; gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implement: critical hits restore 3 mana and extend flow window by 0.5s (capped at 2x window).
